evidence.quote: it has been appropriate for the Federal Reserve to continue to pursue a highly accommodative monetary policy.
Both total and core inflation were only about 1 percent over the 12 months ending in March, below the FOMC's long-run objective of 2 percent.
the U.S. economy has continued to recover from the effects of the financial crisis and deep recession, though at a pace that has been disappointingly slow.
both the tax legislation signed into law in January and the sharp spending cuts associated with sequestration will likely significantly hinder GDP growth this year.
available research suggests that our previous asset purchases have eased financial conditions and provided meaningful support to the economic recovery.
